description.value: Old Yale Brewing Co. is an award-winning craft brewery and kitchen that has been brewing since 1999, now running three taprooms across BC and Alberta. The Abbotsford location pours 15+ craft beers on tap and serves a full Campfire Kitchen menu in a family- and dog-friendly space with outdoor patio seating. Touring cyclists will find a well-rounded stop with a broad food and drink menu, including non-alcoholic options, in a comfortable sit-down setting.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (8 spaces) at 33m; stands (4 spaces) at 36m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Abbotsford location at 33738 Laurel St, Abbotsford, BC V2S 1X2, matching the OSM address, and provides a BC phone number absent from OSM. The FAQ page explicitly states the menu includes vegetarian, vegan-friendly, and gluten-friendly items; OSM tags confirm toilets (customers) and takeaway=yes. Wi-Fi is supported by OSM's internet_access=wlan / internet_access:fee=no tags but is not explicitly mentioned in the fetched website text.
concerns: OSM community field is set to 'Chilliwack' but the business address is in Abbotsford — likely a data-entry error in community assignment.
No phone number in OSM; (604) 392-2011 sourced from website only, so phone confirmation is one-sided.
Wi-Fi confirmed via OSM tag only (internet_access=wlan); website content does not mention it explicitly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible craft brewery and full-service pub with confirmed address and active website; a solid food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists.
